course.title: Unity Advanced
course.subtitle: Performance, DOTS, Rendering, Netcode & Pipeline in Unity 6
course.description: The third course in the ladder after Unity Fundamentals and Unity Intermediate. A focused, deep dive into professional Unity 6 engineering: advanced architecture and async, performance engineering, the Job System and Burst, DOTS/ECS, advanced rendering and HLSL, multiplayer netcode, editor tooling and Addressables, and testing, CI and shipping.

author.name: Ray de la Paz
author.bio: Technical trainer, full-stack developer, and course developer with 30+ years of experience.

modules.title: Advanced Architecture & Async
modules.description: Structure a large project and control the flow of time: assembly definitions, dependency injection, async/await with Awaitable, and design patterns at scale.

lessons.title: Assembly Definitions & Structuring a Large Project
Scaling Design Patterns — Command, State, Service Locator & Event Bus
Mini-Project: A Game Bootstrapper with a Service Container

modules.title: Performance Engineering
modules.description: Measure before you optimize. The Profiler and Memory Profiler in depth, garbage-free C#, and how modern URP batches your draw calls.

lessons.title: Draw Calls & Batching — SRP Batcher, GPU Instancing & the GPU Resident Drawer
Mini-Project: Profiling & Fixing a Stress Scene

modules.title: The Job System & Burst
modules.description: Think in data, not objects. Schedule safe multithreaded work with the C# Job System, NativeContainers, and compile it to blazing native code with Burst.

lessons.title: Mini-Project: A Burst-Compiled Parallel Field Simulation

modules.title: DOTS / ECS
modules.description: The Entity Component System — Unity's data-oriented stack for simulating hundreds of thousands of objects. Entities, components, systems, queries, and baking authoring GameObjects into entities.

lessons.title: The ECS Mindset — Entities, Components & Systems

modules.title: Advanced Rendering
modules.description: Go beyond Shader Graph. Read the frame, write real HLSL shaders, inject custom passes with Scriptable Renderer Features, and run general-purpose GPU work with compute shaders.

lessons.title: The URP Frame & the Frame Debugger
Mini-Project: A Custom Post-Process Renderer Feature

modules.title: Multiplayer — Netcode for GameObjects
modules.description: Build networked games with Unity's official Netcode for GameObjects: the client/server model, spawning and ownership, synchronized NetworkVariables, and RPCs.

lessons.title: Mini-Project: A Small Authoritative Multiplayer Prototype

modules.title: Editor Tooling & Addressables
modules.description: Bend the Editor to your workflow with custom inspectors and UI Toolkit EditorWindows, then manage content asynchronously at scale with the Addressables system.

lessons.title: Mini-Project: A Level-Layout Tool with Addressable Loading

modules.title: Testing, CI & Shipping
modules.description: Ship with confidence: automated tests with the Unity Test Framework, continuous integration and cloud builds, live-ops, and a final tested, CI-built release — plus where to go next.

lessons.title: The Unity Test Framework — Edit & Play Mode Tests
Live-Ops — Analytics, Remote Config & Crash Reporting
Mini-Project: A Tested, CI-Built Release — and Where to Go Next
